tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.1:1).

tokens.name: impact-purple
tokens.usage: Transformation, dignity, empowerment. Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-title`, `.program-title`. 5.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.header`, `.card-action`, `.alert`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change`, `.status-active`, `.impact-high`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: warning-amber
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.neutral`, `.status-upcoming`, `.impact-medium`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
